title: Count the lines of a file
iWant: to count the lines of a text file
soThat: I know its length without opening it

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] tally <file> prints the line count of the file and exits 0.
[failure] tally <file> for a file that does not exist prints an error naming the path and exits 1.
[must-not] tally never writes to the file it reads.
